claim_checks.claim: 4D denotes time-indexed RGB-D/point-cloud evolution; default deployment has no dense 4D output
default register count is 960 from 12x10 cells over 8 future frames
future actions cannot attend future video or registers
depth loss updates backbone, registers, blocks, projection, and geometric head
default inference removes geometry and uses action-only denoising with KV cache
WAM4D average RoboTwin is 91.8, equal Fast-WAM and below LingBot-VA 92.3
latency/memory measured on one A800 80GB; paper reports no FLOPs
real-world average is 0.90 over four tasks with ten rollouts each
Light-WAM/ImageWAM/MemoryWAM mechanisms are not established here
default 960 registers equal a 12x10 mosaic grid over eight future depth frames; depth blocks follow layers 12/14/16/18
register Q attends register plus valid-history KV; text is cross-attended; future action is masked from registers/future video
final DA3 head is pretrained-initialized and trainable; depth loss reaches shared backbone and all readout modules
default inference removes register/depth/future-video branches, refreshes video/action caches, and uses 10-step action denoising
real-world protocol has only 10 physical rollouts per task
paper reports no experimental evidence for Light-WAM, ImageWAM, or MemoryWAM mechanisms
